question_plain: Is this the organisation's purpose, as you want it stated in the operating model?
question_original: Purpose-and-values row 1 of the decision sheet.

asking_form.decision: Accept the purpose statement as drafted from the founding documents

why_it_matters: Every capability of the model serves the purpose; only the governing seat sets it (HF-04).
effect_of_answer: Fixes the purpose every capability serves.

if_unanswered.cost: Gate T8 cannot pass; no release.

minimality_proof.why_unanswered: The articles state objects of the company, not the purpose as the organisation wants it stated in the operating model.
